notes: Region pack for Kruger National Park and the bushveld around it: the lowveld of Mpumalanga and Limpopo (Sabi Sand, Satara, Letaba, Olifants, Mopani, Pafuri, Punda Maria), the Waterberg, Nylsvley and Pilanesberg. Hand-picked on top of the South Africa trip, which already holds the big Kruger names (hornbills, rollers, bee-eaters, vultures, Martial and Bateleur, ground hornbill, shrikes, starlings). This pack adds 71 birds: bushveld hawks and goshawks, White-headed Vulture, snake-eagle and Bat Hawk, the falcons (Dickinson's Kestrel, Red-necked, Red-footed, Hobby), owls (Pel's Fishing-Owl at Pafuri) and nightjars, Racket-tailed Roller and the northern specialities (Collared Palm-Thrush, Arnot's Chat, Bat-like Spinetail, Meves's Starling, Stierling's Wren-Warbler), cuckoos, coursers, weavers, waxbills, whydahs and small woodland birds. Ranked by GBIF/eBird counts (za/occurrence.csv) plus birding knowledge; vagrants and expedition-only birds left out. Birds a visitor to Kruger also meets but that sit in other South Africa packs, so they are not here: Narina Trogon, Brown-crowned Tchagra, Grey-headed Bushshrike, Bennett's Woodpecker, Broad-billed Roller, the kingfishers, African Wood-Owl and Barred Owlet, Spectacled and Grosbeak Weaver, Eastern Nicator, Square-tailed Drongo, Black-bellied Bustard and the wetland birds (ZA-NATAL or ZA-GARDENROUTE); Black-throated Canary and Cinnamon-breasted Warbler (ZA-KAROO); Marsh Owl (ZA-HIGHVELD); Booted Eagle, White Stork and African Goshawk (ZA-FYNBOS). Dropped for lack of trustworthy photos in the library (reviewed from contact sheets): Brown-backed Honeybird, Lesser Honeyguide, Mottled Spinetail, Horus Swift, Grey-rumped Swallow, Rock-loving Cisticola, Tinkling Cisticola, Lesser Spotted Eagle (cannot be told from Greater Spotted Eagle in photos), Shelley's Francolin and Little Sparrowhawk (sheets mix several species). Add them back when reviewed photos exist. Little Heron has no photos at all.
